I skipped writing in this log yesterday.

Would you see it as a bad sign if you skipped your daily activity?

The truth is, though this log is [right now] called Daily Musings Shipped, it’s borne of a larger purpose: to ship something daily. Not necessarily a “musing.” 

Yesterday I shipped a new landing page:

The Cover Letter Creator for Ambitious Job Seekers

Wish you could do more to stand out? You can. Create beautiful, custom-tailored video pitches that win interviews faster. See why pitches win...

crash.co

Took up better than 3 hours of my afternoon, but I shipped it before turning my attention elsewhere. And that is exactly what I was going for when I started this log.

I don’t care so much what I ship each day. Writing is nice; it helps me get my Simple Thoughts out to make room for More Interesting Thoughts. But it’s not about the writing.

It’s about the shipping.
